visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a grey pinstriped oversized blazer over a white t-shirt, stands in a lush outdoor park. The background consists of tall green trees illuminated by soft, natural sunlight. She looks towards the side with a pained facial expression, squinting her eyes and placing her hand with red nail polish and a silver ring over her mouth in a gesture of sudden realization or regret. (2) The scene transitions to the woman leaning her back against a vertical grey concrete pillar in an urban exterior setting. She tilts her head back against the stone surface, looking upwards with an expression of exasperated frustration. Her mouth is slightly open as she reflects on a past action. The lighting remains bright and natural, casting soft shadows on her face. (3) The final visual phase shows the woman crouching low on a paved sidewalk next to a patch of green grass and a metal drain cover. She lowers her head towards her knees, burying her face and letting her long hair fall forward to hide herself. This posture physically represents a deep sense of social shame or the desire to disappear after an awkward encounter.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously illustrate the common feeling of regret and social anxiety that occurs after 'over-sharing' personal information with an acquaintance, using dramatic body language and a fast-paced song to convey an inner sense of panic.
